NewsArticle.Title: Titles
NewsArticle.Content: ... Coming Soon Political: Each active political office displays a title on the Temuair-wide Aislings list. Creative: Winners of Aisling-level award for any creative contest may use their nobility to purchase a noble title for any of the four noble professions: Artist, Bard, Historian, Lorekeeper, or Philosopher. The title appears for a Double-Moon. Event: Arena Hosts may purchase Arena Host title for a large sum of coins for a Double-Moon. Aisling-recognized Event Hosts may similarly purchase an Event Host title for a Double-Moon. An Aisling may only have one title at a time, in this order: - Political position. - Event position. - Creative Nobility; Aislinghood. Title is bestowed and removed at the Threshold to each village. Thereat mundanes will entitle or remove titles based on your active position. This is the most practical way that mundanes can publicize Aisling titles.
